त्रुट् {c4c} {c6c} P. (त्रुट्यति, त्रुटति, त्रुटित)
To tear, break, fall asunder, snap,
be split (fig. also);
गद्गदगलत्त्र्युट्यद्विलीनाक्षरं

त्रुटिः, --टी f. [त्रुट्-इम् वा ङीप्]
1
Cutting, tearing.
--2 A small part, an
atom.
--3 A very minute space of
time equal to (1/4) of a Kṣaṇa or (1/2) of
a Lava.
--4 Doubt, uncertainty.
--5
Loss, destruction.
--6 Small
cardamoms (the plant).

त्रुटिः, --टी f. [त्रुट्-इम् वा ङीप्]
1

--2 A small part, an
atom.
--3 A very minute space of
time equal to (1/4) of a Kṣaṇa or (1/2) of

--4 Doubt, uncertainty.
--5
Loss, destruction.
--6 Small
cardamoms (the plant).

त्रुटित p. p. Cut, broken, divided,
split &c.
